sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

evidence.note: Native 2010 NAIP imagery shows grass along the saved sweeping connector. Imagery is used only to identify the qualification gap, not to invent road-edge coordinates.
Native 2017 NAIP imagery does not establish a paved road matching the saved connector.
Native 2023 NAIP imagery also shows grass along this connector. A physical dry-asphalt racing line is not established.

sourceGeometryReview.note: Unverified estimate for the draft Road Atlanta Short configuration; the connector does not match paved limits in the 2010, 2017 or 2023 imagery checked. Calculate only from the supplied boundary geometry after excluding the pinned near-return spike vertices in a disposable footprint. Every original GeoJSON feature, trace, timing, metadata and terrain remains unchanged. The complete 2.05 m vehicle envelope plus 0.5 m clearance must fit that footprint. Reference search is limited to 2 m, lateral optimization to 1 m and final source-station proximity to 3 m; these are optimization trust limits, not measured road widths. No historical edge, physical drivability, surface grip or real lap-time qualification is claimed. The UI must display Unverified source geometry.
